label: Greater Columbus, OH
_comment_scope: Columbus, OH MSA (OMB 2023) = 10 counties. Franklin alone is a valid 'lite' scope while developing -- it is ~330 tracts vs ~570 for the full MSA.

geoLevels.label: Township / City
geoLevels._note: DEFAULT. Stable across decades: measured 90% of areas have a complete 2009-2024 series, vs 43% for tracts. That is why the timeline lives here. See docs/geography-notes.md.

geoLevels.label: City / Suburb
geoLevels.note: Municipal limits. Only ~78% of the metro lives inside one; unincorporated township land is blank.
geoLevels._note: The colloquial geography -- Dublin, Upper Arlington, Hilliard as residents actually name them, on real annexed city limits that cut across townships and county lines. Medians are PUBLISHED at this level (verified 2009-2024), so no aggregation and no averaging of medians. Two costs: it does not tile the metro (137 places, 78.2% of population; the other 21.8% is unincorporated), and 105 of the 137 places are under 5,000 people, so rule 5 applies harder here than anywhere else.

years._note: VERIFIED against the live API 2026-08-29: ACS5 is published for 2009-2024; 2025 returns 404. ACS 5-year is the only product available at tract level.

boundaryEras._note: VERIFIED by tract counts in Franklin County (39049). THREE eras, not two -- 2009 uses Census 2000 tracts, which is easy to miss.

baseline._note: The 100% index denominator. 'aggregate' recomputes the metro value from component parts (correct for rates/ratios). 'published' pulls the CBSA-level value straight from the API (correct for medians, which cannot be aggregated).
